about: The standard success criteria of every gate (NASL-EMS-HBK-001 section 4.4, version 1.1). Generated from the handbook by framework/tools/extract_gate_criteria.py: do not edit by hand. class M = mandatory (met, or waived by the owner with a reason), D = desirable. A project copies these into its gates, adds its own criteria, and scores each one: met, partly, not met, waived, n/a.

decisions.go: every mandatory criterion met or waived; no Critical or Major RID open
decisions.go with actions: every mandatory criterion met or waived; Major or Minor RIDs open, each on a card with a date; none touches safety
decisions.delta review: one or more mandatory criteria not met, closable within the phase
decisions.no-go: a basic problem: stay in the phase and re-plan

G0.criterion: The need, the goals and the constraints are written
The stakeholders and their needs are listed
An operating concept describes how the product is used
The life cycle is tailored, the WBS and the first cards exist
G0.threshold: every phase-1 card has entry and exit criteria
each High risk has an owner

G1.criterion: Every stakeholder need traces to system requirements
G1.evidence: the trace in the requirements register

G1.criterion: Every requirement meets the quality rules (section 7.2)
Every requirement has a verification method and a planned verification
G1.threshold: 100 % (or recorded as unverifiable, with a reason)

G1.criterion: Every requirement is allocated to subsystems
The functional architecture and the interface document exist and match the model
G1.evidence: the architecture; the interface document; an automatic check

G1.criterion: No TBD on a safety requirement; every other TBD has an owner and a date
Every High risk has a mitigation card
All G1 cards done; no Critical or Major finding open

G2.criterion: The design meets every allocated requirement on paper
The budgets close with the margin set in the project plan
G2.evidence: the budgets: mass, power, energy, thermal, timing

G2.criterion: The interfaces to other subsystems are agreed
G2.evidence: the interface rows, approved by both sides

G2.criterion: The key trade studies are done and recorded
Model or prototype results show feasibility for the riskiest requirements
Every High risk of the subsystem has a mitigation card
All the subsystem's G2 cards done; no Critical finding open

G3.evidence: the builders, models and parameters; the design description
G3.threshold: no open TBD that affects an interface

G3.criterion: The qualification test plan names the test of every requirement
Every High and Mid review item is closed or waived
The subsystem's tests pass against a fresh test baseline
G3.evidence: the test run sorted against the baseline
G3.threshold: 0 new failures; each known failure dispositioned

G3.criterion: The build approach and the configuration (versions) are identified

G4.criterion: An approved procedure exists for every test of the campaign
The test article is identified and matches the baseline
The equipment and environment are ready
G4.threshold: all items ready, calibrated where needed

G4.criterion: A safety plan exists for hardware and field tests
Every test has pass/fail criteria and data recording
The regression checks are green; known failures dispositioned
The open findings of the CDR do not block the campaign

G5.threshold: 100 % passed, or a deviation or waiver approved

G5.criterion: A test report is released for every campaign
The owner accepts the operational scenarios (validation)

G6.criterion: Manufacturing documents, suppliers and processes ready

G7.criterion: The as-built item matches the documents
The software version description is complete
G7.threshold: every model, firmware and package with its version

G7.criterion: Every controlled document is released at its final version
